condition.raw_condition_text: TIRA Test 2200; Polish Standard PN-81/C-89034; 100 mm/min; 23 °C; pieces 1 mm thick and 6 mm wide cut from sheet pressed at 10 MPa. Replicate count and humidity are not reported.
TPU immersed/aged in naphthenic solvent for 7 days at 23°C, then tensile strength and elongation were retested; other tensile conditions are not reported.
